title: Robust Long-Tailed Learning under Label Noise
abstract: arXiv:2108.11569v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Long-tailed learning aims to enhance the generalization performance of underrepresented tail classes. However, previous methods have largely overlooked the prevalence of noisy labels in training data. In this paper, we address the challenge of noisy labels in long-tailed learning. We identify a critical issue: the commonly used small-loss noisy label detection criterion fails to perform effectively in long-tailed class distributions. This failure arises from the inherent bias of deep neural networks, which tend to misclassify tail class examples as head classes, leading to unreliable loss calculations. To mitigate this, we propose a novel small-distance criterion that leverages the robustness of learned representations, enabling more accurate identification of correctly-labeled examples across both head and tail classes. translated_title: 标签噪声下的鲁棒长尾学习
translated_abstract: 长尾学习旨在提升欠代表性尾部类别的泛化性能。然而，以往的方法在很大程度上忽视了训练数据中噪声标签普遍存在这一问题。本文研究了长尾学习中噪声标签带来的挑战。我们发现了一个关键问题：常用的基于小损失的噪声标签检测准则在长尾类别分布下无法有效发挥作用。这种失效源于深度神经网络的固有偏差——网络倾向于将尾部类别的样本误分类为头部类别，从而导致不可靠的损失计算。为缓解这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的基于小距离的准则，该准则利用了所学表示的鲁棒性，能够更准确地识别头部和尾部类别中标签正确的样本。此外，为了改进尾部类别的训练，我们用标签分布替代离散的伪标签来……
tldr: 该论文发现传统的小损失噪声标签检测准则因深度网络将尾部类别误判为头部类别的固有偏差而在长尾分布下失效，并提出利用所学表示鲁棒性的小距离准则来准确识别标签正确的样本，同时用标签分布替代离散伪标签以改进尾部类别的训练。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the conventional small-loss noisy label detection criterion fails under long-tailed distributions due to deep networks' inherent bias of misclassifying tail examples as head classes, and proposes a robust small-distance criterion leveraging learned representations for accurate identification of correctly-labeled examples, along with replacing discrete pseudo-labels with label distributions to improve tail-class training.
